name: Mikazuchi
source:
One of Ryuuga's loyal demon servants. When Ryuuga is awakened by Mizuchi he seeks him out. He prefers subterfuge to fighting though he can easily wipe out police forces as well.

His specialty is in creating monsters, anything from tentacles to insects. He is also a master of illusion.
